article.notFoundDesc: This story may have been removed or expired. Check back later.
outletPickupBody: Buy from any shop, market or mall in your city and hand the bag to a SEIRS rider instead of carrying it home yourself. You give us the shop address, we handle the pickup.
1. Shop normally and pay at the till
2. Open Send a package and enter the shop as the pickup address
3. Track the rider in this app until the bag is handed over
- Groceries, household items, baby supplies and everyday shopping
- Frozen and chilled items, if you pick a covered vehicle
- Anything legal that fits the vehicle you booked
> Tell the rider exactly where to meet you: a shop entrance, a stall number, a gate. A clear meeting point saves everyone a phone call.
Check the weight and size against the vehicle list before you pick one. An okada takes a small bag, a keke takes a full trolley, a danfo or van takes a bulk load.
Open Send a package to try it now.
tipScheduleBody: If you have been booking deliveries on the fly, scheduling the pickup an hour ahead gives your driver time to reach you without fighting traffic, and it lets you choose the window instead of taking whatever is free.
Scheduled pickups let drivers plan a route around several bookings, so fewer of them are crossing town empty. You also lock the pickup into a slot you actually chose.
3. Pick any slot between 5 AM and 9 PM
- Weekday mornings between 9 AM and 11 AM, drivers are freshly active and roads have cleared
- Mid-afternoons (2-4 PM), between school runs and rush hour
- Avoid Friday evenings after 5 PM, that's our busiest window
> Pick a window you will actually be free in. A scheduled pickup only helps if someone is there to hand the package over.
featureMultistopBody: Need to drop off at several places in one trip? Multi-stop is built for exactly that: sending invoices across an estate, fulfilling a wedding-gift list, distributing church communion bags, or paying suppliers in one route.
2. Add a package for each drop-off, each with its own receiver, weight and photo
3. Pay once for the whole run
Every package gets its own tracking code, so each receiver can follow their parcel without seeing anyone else's.
You pay the road distance of the whole route plus a small per-stop fee, shown in your quote before you pay. It is one driver and one trip, so it costs far less than booking each drop separately.
- Up to 5 packages in one booking
- A different receiver name, phone and note per package
- One vehicle sized for the whole load
Tap Send a package and add another package to try it.
referralBody: Invite a friend to SEIRS. When they complete their first qualifying delivery, your referral bonus lands in your points balance.
- Your referral bonus lands the moment a friend completes their first qualifying delivery
- The bonus is per friend, and the current rate is shown on your Rewards tab
- There is a monthly cap on referral bonuses, so the programme stays sustainable
Your friend joins with your code on their account, which is what links their first delivery back to you.
3. Apply up to ₦100 worth of points per booking
> A few customers in Yaba and Surulere have turned referrals into ₦10,000+ of credit just by inviting their WhatsApp groups. Worth trying.
Tap Send a package and check Rewards to start sharing your code.
